'''''Wookiee World Horror Witness!''''' was a [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]] feature released in [[41 ABY]] to [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] channels. It featured [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tirs Maladane]] of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial II-class Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] recounting the events of the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], in which the forests of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] were set ablaze by the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] guns of the ''Anakin Solo''.<ref name="TEGtW" />
